title: spin-noise network bundle metadata (meta.json), schema version 2.0
description: Metadata record placed at the root of every spin-noise bundle zip. Written by topspin/spin_noise_run.py (Bruker, schema 1.2) or packer/pack_bundle.py (any vendor, schema 2.0); validated by uploader/upload_bundle.py --selftest. This file describes schema version 2.0, which makes the contract vendor-neutral: a required top-level 'vendor' enum plus a vendor-namespaced 'instrument' object hold everything instrument-specific (Bruker: TopSpin version + BSMS sweep state; JEOL and Magritek blocks are drafts pending partner/bench validation), while the 'spectrometer' common core keeps only vendor-neutral physics (frequency, field, probe class, temperatures). BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY: bundles declaring 1.0/1.1/1.2 remain valid and are validated against their own vintage of the contract (the uploader re-tightens the v1.x requireds: 'topspin_version' back into spectrometer, 'lock_sweep_confirmed_off' back into environment) with an ABSENT vendor treated as 'bruker'. History: 1.0 = initial contract; 1.1 = added the required 'software' object; 1.2 = added the optional 'clock_audit' object; 2.0 = vendor enum + vendor-namespaced 'instrument' blocks (Bruker-specific fields moved out of the common core). NOTE: the uploader ships a deliberately minimal built-in validator (type / required / enum / const / pattern / items only) so this schema intentionally avoids $ref, allOf, conditionals, and other advanced keywords; the rule 'instrument must contain the block named by vendor' cannot be expressed in that subset and is enforced in uploader/packer code instead.

schema_version.description: Version of this metadata schema. Bump only with coordinated uploader/server changes. History: 1.0 = initial contract; 1.1 = added the required 'software' object; 1.2 = added the optional 'clock_audit' object; 2.0 = vendor-neutral core (required 'vendor' enum + vendor-namespaced 'instrument' blocks). 1.x bundles remain valid; absent vendor means 'bruker'.

program_version.description: Version string of the program that produced this bundle (spin_noise_run.py or pack_bundle.py; kept for 1.0 continuity, duplicates software.script_version).

script_version.description: Version constant of the script that wrote this bundle (SCRIPT_VERSION of spin_noise_run.py, or PACKER_VERSION of pack_bundle.py); matches the repository VERSION file for released code.

schema_version.description: Schema version the writing script targeted; duplicates the top-level schema_version for self-contained provenance.

script_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the running writer script file, computed at runtime (works without git on facility machines); 'unavailable' if it could not be determined. Optional.

writer.description: Which program wrote the bundle, e.g. 'topspin/spin_noise_run.py' or 'packer/pack_bundle.py'. Optional (new in 2.0).

run_mode.description: How the data came to be: 'live' = real acquisition by the orchestrator; 'simulate'/'desktest' = hardware commands mocked, bundle is a plumbing test, NOT data; 'archival-repackage' = real historical spectrometer data repackaged into the bundle format; 'synthetic-injection' = numerically synthesized data with a known injected feature, used to validate the analysis pipeline (never a science result); 'external-acquisition' = real data acquired by the facility's own vendor software (e.g. Delta, SpinsolveExpert, or manual TopSpin operation) and packed by packer/pack_bundle.py. Optional; enum extension is backward compatible.

software.description: Provenance of the software that produced the bundle. Required from schema 1.1 onward.

created_utc.description: UTC timestamp of bundle creation, ISO 8601 with trailing Z, e.g. 2026-08-18T14:03:22Z.

local_timezone_offset_min.description: Local timezone offset from UTC in minutes at creation time (e.g. +120 for CEST). Lets us reconstruct local time-of-day for environmental-noise correlation.

vendor.description: Instrument vendor (required from 2.0). Determines which block of 'instrument' applies and which reader/adapter produced the data/ tree. 1.x bundles carry no vendor field; validators and analysis treat an ABSENT vendor as 'bruker' (every 1.x writer was the TopSpin orchestrator). 'agilent' (added within 2.0; enum extension is backward compatible -- no existing bundle carried it) covers the Agilent/Varian VnmrJ and OpenVnmrJ lineage.

facility_slug.description: Short lowercase identifier assigned by the maintainer; also appears in the bundle filename.

contact_email.description: Optional contact address; empty string if not provided. Only stored when contact_consent is true.

contact_consent.description: True only if the operator explicitly consented to storing contact_email.

spectrometer.description: Vendor-NEUTRAL common physics core (2.0): the quantities every analysis needs regardless of who built the instrument. Vendor-specific software versions and console state live in instrument.<vendor>. In 1.x this block also carried the required Bruker field 'topspin_version'; it is kept below as an OPTIONAL deprecated alias so 1.x bundles and old tooling keep working.

topspin_version.description: DEPRECATED alias (required through 1.2, moved to instrument.bruker.topspin_version in 2.0). Writers targeting 2.0 should put it in the bruker block; readers should look in both places.

h1_freq_mhz.description: 1H Larmor frequency of the magnet in MHz (BF1 on Bruker). Vendor-neutral: this is the axion-mass coordinate of the site.

console.description: Instrument/console identification as reported or entered, e.g. 'Avance III HD', 'JNM-ECZL 500G', 'Spinsolve 60 Carbon'. Empty string if unknown.

probe_string.description: Verbatim probe identification string (PROBHD on Bruker; probe/model text elsewhere). Empty string if the instrument has no separate probe identity (benchtop systems).

probe_type.description: RT = room-temperature probe (expect Gueron absorption dip); cryoprobes expect emission bump; permanent-magnet-benchtop = Magritek-class integrated RT probe on a permanent magnet (Gueron-dip physics, no separate probe hardware). Enum extension in 2.0 is backward compatible: 1.x bundles only ever carried the first four values.

coil_temp_k.description: RF coil temperature in kelvin if known; null otherwise.

preamp_temp_k.description: Preamplifier temperature in kelvin if known; null otherwise.

instrument.description: Vendor-namespaced instrument details (required from 2.0). MUST contain the block named by the top-level 'vendor' field -- the uploader and packer enforce that in code (the minimal validator subset cannot express it). Other blocks are permitted but ignored. The bruker block is exactly the Bruker-specific fields that lived in the 1.x common core (TopSpin version; BSMS sweep state); the jeol and magritek blocks are the contract packages B and C fill in -- their field lists are DRAFTS pending partner/bench validation and were designed against the JEOL Delta/.jdf and Magritek SpinsolveExpert/Prospa converter paths.

topspin_version.description: TopSpin version, e.g. '4.1.4' (moved here from spectrometer.topspin_version, which remains as a deprecated alias).

bsms_field_sweep_confirmed_off.description: Operator explicitly confirmed the BSMS field sweep was OFF during the noise block (moved here from environment.lock_sweep_confirmed_off, which remains as a deprecated alias). A running sweep smears the noise feature by kHz and ruins the record -- the 2022 lesson.

console_raw.description: Verbatim console line from uxnmr.info if available. Optional.

rga_used.description: Whether receiver-gain optimization (rga) chose the noise-block RG. Optional; null if unknown.

jeol.description: DRAFT (package B/C contract; not yet validated on JEOL hardware). Field semantics follow JEOL Delta and the .jdf single-file format as documented by the open-source cheminfo/jeolconverter parser (MIT), which package work may port with attribution; every mapping must be confirmed at the partner facility before this block is treated as authoritative.

delta_version.description: JEOL Delta software version that acquired/exported the data. UNVERIFIED how best to read this programmatically; operator-entered until the partner-facility session confirms a machine-readable source.

spectrometer_model.description: e.g. 'JNM-ECZL 500G'. Optional; operator-entered or parsed from the .jdf header (header field names pending validation against jeolconverter).

data_format.description: Source format of the files under data/: native .jdf, or the Delta JCAMP-DX export fallback.

receiver_gain.description: Receiver gain as reported by Delta, in JEOL's native units. UNVERIFIED: unit convention and parameter name vary by model/version; record verbatim, calibrate at the partner facility. Null if unknown.

field_state_notes.description: Free text on lock/field state during the noise block (JEOL consoles have no BSMS; the equivalent 'is anything sweeping B0' confirmation is captured here until a vendor-specific checklist is validated). Empty string allowed.

magritek.description: DRAFT (package B/C contract; scripted path pending bench validation on a Spinsolve). Field semantics follow the Spinsolve/Prospa file conventions (acqu.par acquisition-parameter file; data.1d/fid.1d raw data; proc.par under SpinsolveExpert) as documented by nmrglue's spinsolve reader; every mapping must be confirmed on a real bench before this block is treated as authoritative.

spinsolve_software_version.description: Spinsolve (or SpinsolveExpert) software version. UNVERIFIED best machine-readable source; operator-entered until bench validation.

prospa_version.description: Prospa version, when the scripted (Prospa-macro) path acquired the data. Optional.

expert_mode.description: True if SpinsolveExpert (scripting-capable) drove the acquisition; false for the standard Spinsolve UI; null if unknown.

rx_gain.description: Receiver gain setting from acqu.par, in Magritek's native units. UNVERIFIED parameter name/units pending bench validation. Null if unknown.

data_format.description: Source format of the files under data/: native Prospa binary (data.1d family) or the JCAMP-DX export.

agilent.description: DRAFT (converter path; not yet validated on Agilent hardware -- partner facility: 400 MHz Agilent DD2 running VnmrJ 3.2). Field semantics follow the Varian/Agilent fid + procpar file family as documented by nmrglue's varian reader (BSD-3-Clause), with the MAGICAL macro lineage shared by VnmrJ and the open-source OpenVnmrJ continuation (github.com/OpenVnmrJ); every mapping must be confirmed at the partner facility before this block is treated as authoritative.

vnmrj_version.description: VnmrJ (or OpenVnmrJ) software version that acquired the data, e.g. '3.2'. UNVERIFIED whether procpar carries a reliable machine-readable source; operator-entered until the partner-facility session confirms one.

data_format.description: Source format of the files under data/: 'varian-fid' = native .fid save directories (procpar + fid [+ text, log]).

receiver_gain_db.description: Receiver gain ('gain' parameter) in dB, verbatim from procpar, for the noise block. UNVERIFIED: range/step/linearity per console model pending the partner ladder measurement. Null if unknown. (The per-experiment meta 'rg' carries the Bruker-comparable linear amplitude 10^(gain/20).)

field_state_notes.description: Free text on lock/z0 state during the noise block (Agilent consoles have no Bruker BSMS; the equivalent 'is anything sweeping or stepping B0' confirmation is captured here until a vendor-specific checklist is validated). Empty string allowed.

nanalysis.description: DRAFT (converter-first Nanalysis NMReady path; pending partner validation on a 60 MHz NMReady 60PRO). Field semantics follow the JCAMP-DX exports of the NMReady touchscreen software as verified against Nanalysis Corp.'s own open-source jcamp-parser test corpus (real v2.2.4.5 instrument output); every mapping must be confirmed on the partner's unit before this block is treated as authoritative.

software_version.description: NMReady software version, machine-readable from the ##JCAMP-DX label comment ('$$ Nanalysis NMReady v2.2.6.2'); operator-entered if the export omits it.

firmware_version.description: Instrument firmware version, operator-entered (no machine-readable source verified). Optional.

data_format.description: Source format of the files under data/: the NMReady exports JCAMP-DX (FID as NTUPLES, spectrum as XYDATA) and csv.

receiver_gain.description: ##$RECVR_GAIN verbatim, in Nanalysis's native units. UNVERIFIED units/linearity -- record verbatim, calibrate at the partner session. Null if unknown.

lock_nucleus.description: Lock channel nucleus during the noise block: '2H', '1H', 'off', or 'unknown'. The NMReady has an internal 1H-or-2H lock; whether it can be disabled or radiates in-band during acquisition is a partner-session question.

field_state_notes.description: Free text on lock/shim/drift state during the noise block (the NMReady analog of the Bruker BSMS sweep confirmation: is anything actively stepping B0 between or during records?). Empty string allowed.

description.description: Free text, e.g. 'tap water', 'distilled water + 10% D2O'.

h2o_fraction_pct.description: Protonated-water fraction in percent. Critical: the spin-noise feature scales with proton density (the 2022 lesson).

vt_setpoint_k.description: Variable-temperature setpoint in kelvin (or ambient bore/magnet temperature where there is no VT unit); sample temperature enters the noise-power law via Ts.

environment.description: Vendor-neutral run environment. In 1.x this block also required the Bruker field 'lock_sweep_confirmed_off'; from 2.0 that lives in instrument.bruker.bsms_field_sweep_confirmed_off and is kept below as an OPTIONAL deprecated alias.

locked.description: Whether a field-frequency lock was engaged during the noise acquisition (false for lockless systems such as benchtops).

lock_sweep_confirmed_off.description: DEPRECATED alias (required through 1.2, moved to instrument.bruker.bsms_field_sweep_confirmed_off in 2.0). Bruker writers may keep mirroring it here for old tooling.

operator_notes.description: Free text: construction nearby, elevator, He fill that morning, etc. Empty string allowed.

p90_us.description: Calibrated (or operator-entered) 1H 90-degree pulse length in microseconds.

p90_power_db_or_w.description: Power level at which p90_us applies. Number in dB (Avance III+) or watts; string allowed for consoles that report e.g. '-6 dB PLW1' or where the value was not retained.

rg.description: Receiver gain in the VENDOR'S native units (Bruker RG; JEOL/Magritek gain settings -- see instrument.<vendor> for unit provenance).

rg_ladder.description: Small-flip 1D acquisitions at increasing receiver gain, used offline to check receiver linearity.

topshim_ok.description: True if automated shimming ran and converged (topshim on Bruker; the vendor's equivalent elsewhere); false if unavailable or skipped.

rd_optimize.description: OPTIONAL (documented 2026-08-31, no schema-version bump: an additive, never-required object that changes no validation outcome for any existing bundle). Written by spin_noise_run.py when the 'rdopt' option ran: the probe-tuning scan for maximum radiation damping. Keys: enabled, offsets_khz, decay_rates_per_s (FID envelope decay = 1/T2* + lambda_r per offset; null where unmeasurable), amplitudes, scan_expnos, chosen_offset_khz, improvement_frac, final_retune_ok, p90_us_at_setup / p90_us_at_chosen (P90 is recalibrated at the chosen tuning; the session's calibration.p90_us is the recalibrated value), note.

role.description: Experiment role. rdopt_scan (small-flip 1Ds of the rd-optimize tuning scan), sweep_verify (field-step verification 1Ds), and noise_sweep (per-step pulse-free noise blocks of the field-stepped sweep) were added for the optional rdopt/sweep features; enum extension only, all earlier bundles remain valid.

pulprog.description: Pulse program / experiment name, e.g. 'zgnoise2d' for the Bruker noise block; the vendor's sequence name elsewhere.

td.description: Points per row (direct dimension), in the vendor's raw-point convention (Bruker: complex-pair count TD).

td1_rows.description: Number of pseudo-2D rows / repeated records (1 for plain 1Ds).

rg.description: Receiver gain in the vendor's native units.

started_local.description: Local wall-clock start, ISO 8601 without zone (zone given by local_timezone_offset_min).

clock_audit.description: OPTIONAL (added in schema 1.2; absent from 1.0/1.1 bundles and from packer-produced bundles whose source data carries no block timestamps -- no penalty). Software-only console-clock audit: spectrometer acquisition durations derive from the console's OCXO master clock, while the workstation wall clock is normally NTP-disciplined, so comparing OCXO-implied and wall-clock elapsed time across blocks measures the fractional console-clock offset (precision ~ NTP timestamp jitter / time span). Written by spin_noise_run.py v0.2+; analyzed by analysis/facility_report.py.

role.description: Same role vocabulary as experiments[].role, including the optional rdopt/sweep feature roles (enum extension; earlier bundles remain valid).

wall_start_ms.description: Workstation wall-clock milliseconds since the Unix epoch, recorded immediately before the block's acquisition started.

wall_end_ms.description: Workstation wall-clock milliseconds recorded immediately after the block's acquisition completed.

ocxo_expected_s.description: OCXO-implied block duration in seconds, computed from the acquisition parameters (rows * ns * (TD/(2*SW_h) + delays)). Null for blocks whose duration is not OCXO-predictable (the setup block: tune/shim/pulsecal plus operator dialogs); such blocks are excluded from the offset fit.

blocks.description: One entry per acquisition block, in session order. TopSpin's script layer cannot see individual rows of a pseudo-2D acquisition, so the audit is block-level by construction.

ntp_status_raw.description: Raw output of the first time-sync status probe that answered (chronyc tracking / ntpq -pn / timedatectl / w32tm), captured once per session; 'unavailable' if none did.

workstation_time_source.description: Short label of the tool that answered the time-sync probe (e.g. 'chrony', 'ntpd (ntpq)', 'w32time'); 'unknown' if none did.

field_sweep.description: OPTIONAL (documented 2026-08-31, no schema-version bump: additive and never required). Written by spin_noise_run.py when the 'sweep' option ran: field-stepped noise blocks, each step a distinct axion mass point. The field is stepped through the 2H lock reference (1 ppm = BF1 Hz at 1H, exact) with unlocked FIELD-DAC steps as fallback; MEASURED offsets, never targets, are the record. Keys: enabled, requested_half_span_hz, per_step_secs, baseline_line_offset_hz, sign_convention_flip (pulse-pair estimator sign resolved against the operator's shift direction), steps[] {index, target_offset_hz, measured_offset_hz (null = unverified: analysis must not substitute the target), measured_offset_hz_raw, verify_expno, noise_expno, rows, skipped}, restored_offset_hz, field_restored, ended_early, note.

checksums.description: Map from in-zip path (always under data/) to its SHA-256, e.g. {"data/12/ser": "sha256:ab12..."}.
